_comment: Registration for a thick-tissue acquisition whose protein channel sits on a
late imaging round and whose polyT/DAPI live in a separate file.
PolyWarp registers EVERY channel the dataorganization describes, so giving
the protein round a row of its own removes the need for a standalone offset
script beside the pipeline. That matters: one such script re-implemented a
subset of this task's filter and peak search and inherited neither the median
filter (single hot pixels, fixed to the detector, correlate with themselves at
zero lag) nor the bounded peak search (a dense self-similar bead field locks
onto a secondary maximum of its own autocorrelation).
rigid_plane_search is ON because a 2D bead frame can give a confident-looking,
in-band answer that deeper planes show is wrong by tens of pixels.
See README.md for the measured numbers behind each setting.
